dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are visible on the upper dorsal region. These exhibit jagged, high-frequency perimeters where dark grey centers transition sharply into light grey outer boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid dark pixels clustered primarily at the margins of the larger annuli and along the lateral transition zone where the complex pattern meets the more uniform dark grey posterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal rings form an irregular quadrilateral arrangement, with the primary diagonal axis aligned longitudinally along the spine.

other_distinctive_markers: The hind flippers exhibit five distinct longitudinal deep folds or grooves, creating a high-contrast fan-like texture at the posterior terminal.
